CRP.notes: No dairy cream powder found in Maltese shops, and no verified seller of 38-48 % cream powder listing Malta. Only lead: a UK shop (75 % fat) with generic international delivery. Discovery constrained (WebSearch budget exhausted, Brave mostly HTTP 429). | Gap closed 2026-09-17 by research-gap-eu: the confirmed 42 % spray-dried cream powder is also sold by shop.cake-masters.com (the Herzlake group's TRADE shop), whose own foreign shipping-cost table prints a row for this market — so delivery here is verified in the seller's own words, unlike the group's consumer shops. Caveat for the owner: that shop states "Verkauf nur an registrierte, gewerbliche Wiederverkäufer." and quotes prices net of VAT, i.e. it is a B2B channel; the pack itself (100 g) is retail size. No consumer-facing seller of a 38-48 % dairy cream powder that names this market was found. Second Malta-naming seller found (ecolebensmittel.com) but its cream-powder listing is out of stock and carries an Amazon ASIN as its article number, so it was not proposed.
